semantic.justification: Original public uno::Environment resolved-pointer/default/copy/move ownership, pointer/copy/move assignment, destruction, clear/get/is and owned getTypeName/borrowed getContext accessors. Actual C environment callbacks and OUString owners are reused. Pointer/copy assignment skips identical pointers; differing pointers acquire new before releasing old and publishing. Clear releases before null publication; self-move releases and clears. Type-name returns own exact Unicode/NUL descriptor references, while context is passed through without address synthesis or identity conversion. Whole original environment.hxx plus unchanged lbenv.cxx and real DefaultEnvironment callbacks supply complete normal-ASan/UBSan identical ownership/accessor streams. Enclosing input records are not production environment constructors/providers. Descriptor/current lookup, invoke/enter/isValid purpose-stack APIs, public bootstrap/application installation, physical ABI/allocator/concurrency/noexcept termination/leaks and full upstream consumer QA remain incomplete or unverified.
